storyCards.headline: Runaway: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Janet Jackson's "Runaway" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Runaway" is a song by American singer-songwriter Janet Jackson from her first greatest hits album, Design of a Decade: 1986–1996 (1995).

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Runaway was released in 1995.

Album: Design Of A Decade 1986/1996 (1995).

Chart story — peaked at #3 on the Hot 100.
